label.rationale: CI Summary, the only non-green required context, failed at its 90-minute poll deadline; the companion OCC#11331 had merged. ci.yml changed on dev twice since the head's 2026-09-25 merge base, so a re-run would replay the old caller; the remedy is update-branch.

provenance.read: GitHub REST check-runs API at the head sha, every page, filter=all; failed-step, run and annotation facts from the jobs, runs and annotations APIs; named_blockers parsed from the CI Summary job's own final report
provenance.reconstruction_rule: Snapshot as of observed_at, rebuilt from the live read: copies that started after observed_at are left out, a copy that completed after it reads in_progress, the caller-change flag is recomputed against the last base commit before observed_at, and the companion state comes from its created, merged and closed times. merge_state is not recoverable for a past moment; it is reconstructed as blocked because the required CI Summary's newest copy was red at observed_at.
